#  13736 - Lab Course Preparation, Characterization and Application of Activated Carbons Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13736 - module is no longer offered from SS 2025**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Lab Course Preparation, Characterization and Application of Activated Carbons**  |  
|  Laborkurs Synthese, Charakterisierung und Verwendung von Aktivkohlen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr. rer. nat. Wilker, Viola 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. Klepel, Olaf 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students acquire - basic knowledge of laboratory tasks and associated safety aspects - basic knowledge on porous materials and adsorption processes - basic knowledge on the preparation of activated carbons basic knowledge on the textural characterization of porous materials.  |  
| Contents:  | - basic skills of laboratory work - preparation and activation of carbon materials - characterization of porous carbons by adsorption methods - application of porous carbons in environmentally relevant processes   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | 13110 Basic Natural Sciences  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Laboratory training / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Practical training script
  * scientific literature

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Scientific report on the laboratory experiments  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | 10  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  **For students of ERM only** , the first part of the course (basic skills of laboratory work) takes place in Cottbus, the other parts in Senftenberg  |  
| Module Components:  |  _-_ Lab course  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
